dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, Adrian. Rachel Lim speaking. Thanks for calling. Have you managed to get a quiet moment between your meetings? We can keep the conversation focused, and you can let me know if you need a pause.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hi Rachel. Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. It's been a busy morning with consulting work, but I've put aside some time for this call. My NRIC is S six five three two five three nine A. My date of birth is the sixteenth of May nineteen ninety-eight.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep things concise. We can take the conversation in stages, rather than trying to cover everything in one stretch.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The fund I want to transact in is Nova Technology Equity Fund. I want to buy, please. I have 5,000 units in mind, but let me settle the details before committing to that quantity. I've got my notes in front of me, so I shouldn't need to search through anything while we're talking.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: All right, I'll leave you room to refer to your notes as we talk. I recommend buying Nova Technology Equity Fund.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Okay, noted. Please use euros as the transaction currency. The amount I am committing to this transaction is 1,000,000. My earlier investment in this fund was 150,000 euros. That's just my budgeting history, not the amount for today's instruction.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: For illustration only, a subscription of 100,000 euros would translate into units based on the applicable unit price. That example is not your current order amount.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: All right. By the way, these telephone appointments are much easier to fit around work. A branch visit usually means rearranging meetings and allowing extra time for travelling.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Noted on the appointment format. Let me cover the next part of our conversation now. dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. A change in sentiment towards technology shares can make the fund's value fluctuate sharply.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You could lose part or even all of the money you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this investment?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses and substantial fluctuations in value.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. On the scheduling side, would you prefer future telephone appointments to be arranged through you directly, rather than having us coordinate through your office?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Directly with me, please. My team handles the business diary, but I keep personal appointments separate. Sometimes a client meeting runs over, so a little flexibility helps.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Certainly. We can contact you directly about arranging appointments. If your work diary changes, just let us know and we can find another suitable slot.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, that would be helpful. I've finished looking through my notes now. For the final order, use the unit quantity I mentioned earlier. I'm committing to that quantity now. Please place a limit order with a limit price of 200 euros per unit.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. That brings us to the end of today's call. I'll let you get back to your afternoon. I hope the rest of your meetings run on time.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, Rachel. The next one is just with my own team, so at least there's no travelling involved. Appreciate you keeping the call focused. Have a good afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Thanks for making the time to speak today. Have a good afternoon too. Goodbye.
